package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/projectauthoring"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const maximumProjectAuthoringCommandBytes int64 = 16 << 10

type ProjectAuthoringHandler struct{ Commands projectauthoring.Commands }

func (handler ProjectAuthoringHandler) Create(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	pathID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "pathID"))
	key := strings.TrimSpace(request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
	if !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(pathID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(key) {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	var input domain.ProjectAuthoringCreateRequestV1
	if err := decodeProjectAuthoringCommand(writer, request, &input); err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	flow, created, err := handler.Commands.Create(request.Context(), studentID, pathID, key, input)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(writer, status, projectAuthoringProjection(flow))
}

func (handler ProjectAuthoringHandler) Get(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	flowID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "flowID"))
	if !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(flowID) {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	flow, err := handler.Commands.Get(request.Context(), studentID, flowID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, projectAuthoringProjection(flow))
}

func (handler ProjectAuthoringHandler) GetCurrent(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	pathID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "pathID"))
	if !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(pathID) || !emptyProjectAuthoringGet(request) {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	flow, err := handler.Commands.GetCurrent(request.Context(), studentID, pathID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, projectAuthoringProjection(flow))
}

func emptyProjectAuthoringGet(request *http.Request) bool {
	if request.URL.RawQuery != "" || request.URL.ForceQuery || request.ContentLength > 0 || len(request.TransferEncoding) != 0 {
		return false
	}
	if request.Body == nil {
		return true
	}
	var byteBuffer [1]byte
	count, err := request.Body.Read(byteBuffer[:])
	return count == 0 && errors.Is(err, io.EOF)
}

func (handler ProjectAuthoringHandler) Confirm(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	handler.mutate(writer, request, true)
}

func (handler ProjectAuthoringHandler) RequestPublication(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	handler.mutate(writer, request, false)
}

func (handler ProjectAuthoringHandler) mutate(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request, confirmation bool) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	flowID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "flowID"))
	key := strings.TrimSpace(request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
	if !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(flowID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(key) {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	var flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow
	var err error
	if confirmation {
		var input domain.ProjectAuthoringConfirmRequestV1
		if err = decodeProjectAuthoringCommand(writer, request, &input); err == nil {
			flow, err = handler.Commands.Confirm(request.Context(), studentID, flowID, key, input)
		}
	} else {
		var input domain.ProjectAuthoringPublishRequestV1
		if err = decodeProjectAuthoringCommand(writer, request, &input); err == nil {
			flow, err = handler.Commands.RequestPublication(request.Context(), studentID, flowID, key, input)
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusAccepted
	if flow.Status == domain.ProjectAuthoringPublished {
		status = http.StatusOK
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(writer, status, projectAuthoringProjection(flow))
}

func decodeProjectAuthoringCommand(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request, output any) error {
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(request.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || mediaType != "application/json" {
		return domain.ErrMalformed
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, maximumProjectAuthoringCommandBytes))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(output); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrMalformed
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.ErrMalformed
	}
	return nil
}

type projectAuthoringResponse struct {
	Schema                  string                              `json:"schema"`
	FlowID                  string                              `json:"flow_id"`
	Status                  domain.ProjectAuthoringStatus       `json:"status"`
	Version                 int64                               `json:"version"`
	LearningPathID          string                              `json:"learning_path_id"`
	LearningPathVersion     int64                               `json:"learning_path_version"`
	AuthoringProfileVersion int64                               `json:"authoring_profile_version"`
	AuthoringProfileDigest  string                              `json:"authoring_profile_digest"`
	Locale                  string                              `json:"locale"`
	GoalCode                string                              `json:"goal_code"`
	TargetCount             int                                 `json:"target_count"`
	AuthoringJobID          string                              `json:"authoring_job_id,omitempty"`
	AuthoringJobStatus      domain.TZAuthoringJobStatus         `json:"authoring_job_status,omitempty"`
	ReadyBlueprintDigest    string                              `json:"ready_blueprint_digest,omitempty"`
	ReadyCandidateDigest    string                              `json:"ready_candidate_digest,omitempty"`
	PublicationRequested    bool                                `json:"publication_requested"`
	Publication             *domain.ProjectPublicationReceiptV1 `json:"publication,omitempty"`
	Staging                 *domain.ProjectStagingReceiptV1     `json:"staging,omitempty"`
	FailureCode             string                              `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
	Attempts                int                                 `json:"attempts"`
	CreatedAt               string                              `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt               string                              `json:"updated_at"`
}

func projectAuthoringProjection(flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) projectAuthoringResponse {
	response := projectAuthoringResponse{
		Schema: "project-authoring-flow.v1", FlowID: flow.ID, Status: flow.Status, Version: flow.Version,
		LearningPathID: flow.LearningPathID, LearningPathVersion: flow.LearningPathVersion,
		AuthoringProfileVersion: flow.AuthoringProfileVersion, AuthoringProfileDigest: flow.AuthoringProfileDigest,
		Locale: flow.Input.Locale, GoalCode: flow.GoalCode, TargetCount: len(flow.Input.Targets), AuthoringJobID: flow.TZAuthoringJobID,
		AuthoringJobStatus: flow.TZJobStatus, ReadyBlueprintDigest: flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest,
		ReadyCandidateDigest: flow.ReadyCandidateDigest, PublicationRequested: flow.PublicationRequestedAt != nil,
		FailureCode: flow.FailureCode, Attempts: flow.Attempts,
		CreatedAt: flow.CreatedAt.UTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999Z"),
		UpdatedAt: flow.UpdatedAt.UTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999Z"),
	}
	if flow.Publication != nil {
		receipt := *flow.Publication
		response.Publication = &receipt
	}
	if flow.Staging != nil {
		receipt := *flow.Staging
		response.Staging = &receipt
	}
	return response
}
